article.title: Constitutional validity of Central laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 226
article.content: Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 8 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).
article.html:
226AConstitutional validity of Central laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 226

Article 226A · Part VI

Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 8 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 39 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
